bloques.titulo: The border between state and event
texto: The **imperfetto** holds the stage: it describes the environmental conditions, the time and what was going on (* Pioveva forte *, * Cucinavo la dina *).
The **passato prossimo** breaks the stage with a specific event: *

Change of time changes the perspective: **Pioveva quando è arrivato Marco** (the rain was already falling as a background when Marco arrived); instead, **Ha piovuto per due ore** presents the rain as a complete and delimited event.

filas: Ieri ha piovuto tutto il pomeriggio.
Ho letto il libro in tre giorni.
Ero stanco, così sono andato a letto.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: narrative contrast of past times

frases.it: Luca, che cosa è successo ieri sera a casa tua?
frases.es: Luca, ¿qué pasó anoche en tu casa?
frases.en: Luca, what happened last night at your house?

frases.it: Mentre cucinavo la cena, è suonato il telefono.
frases.es: Mientras cocinaba la cena, sonó el teléfono.
frases.en: While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang.
And who was it on the phone?

frases.it: Era Marco! Fuori pioveva e non aveva l'ombrello.
frases.es: ¡Era Marco! Fuera llovía y no tenía paraguas.
frases.en: It was Marco! It was raining outside and it had no umbrella.

frases.it: Che bella sorpresa! E lui è venuto a cena?
frases.es: ¡Qué buena sorpresa! ¿Y él vino a cenar?
frases.en: What a good surprise! And he came to dinner?

frases.it: Sì, è entrato in casa e abbiamo mangiato insieme.
frases.es: Sí, entró en casa y comimos juntos.
frases.en: Yeah, he came in and we ate together.

bloques.pregunta: In the «Pioveva quando è arrivato Marco» phrase, what function does «pioveva» perform?

opciones.texto: It describes the current atmospheric context at the time of arrival.
opciones.explicacion: The imperfect paints the substantive situation on which it affects the timely event.

opciones.texto: It indicates that it started to rain exactly when Marco arrived.
opciones.explicacion: «Pioveva» indicates that the rain was already falling from before.

opciones.texto: Expresa una acción futura prevista en el pronóstico meteorológico.
opciones.explicacion: The verb is in the past, not in the future.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal time corresponds to the action that interrupts in «Mentre cucinavo, ___ il telefono»?

opciones.explicacion: The specific event that interrupts the developing action requires prossimo passage.
It would express a continuous sound without the character of a punctual event switch.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right form to describe atmospheric time.
bloques.frase: ___ quando è arrivato Marco a casa mia.

opciones.explicacion: The weather frame in progress during an arrival is expressed in imperfect.
It would present the rain as a phenomenon already concluded before Marco arrived.

bloques.frase: Mentre cucinavo, è suonato il telefono di casa.

opciones.texto: I was cooking when the phone suddenly rang.
opciones.explicacion: «Mentre cucinavo» marks the ongoing process and «è suonato» the punctual fact.

opciones.texto: The phone rang before I got into the kitchen.
opciones.explicacion: It sounded during the cooking act.

opciones.texto: First I cooked dinner and then I called on the phone myself.
opciones.explicacion: The guy I was cooking wasn't the one who called.

bloques.pregunta: How do you combine both times?
bloques.frase: Ieri sera pioveva, ma siamo usciti insieme.

opciones.texto: «Pioveva» describe el mal tiempo reinante y «siamo usciti» narra la decisión puntual tomada.
opciones.explicacion: Canonical alternative between descriptive framework (imperfect) and event (prossimo passate).

opciones.texto: Both actions were prolonged habits that were repeated every week.
opciones.explicacion: Going out last night was a punctual event («ieri sera»).

opciones.texto: We didn't leave the house because it rained a lot.
opciones.explicacion: The text clearly says they did go out together.

bloques.frase: Mentre leggevo il libro è entrata Sara
bloques.traduccion: As I read the book, Sara came in.
bloques.explicacion: Process in imperfect interrupted by punctual event in prossimo passage.

bloques.pregunta: Why do you say «Mentre camminavo ho visto un amico» and not «Mentre ho camminato...»?

opciones.texto: Porque «mentre» encuadra una acción en desarrollo durante la cual surge otro hecho.
opciones.explicacion: The «mentre» conjunction requires imfect to point to the temporary background.

opciones.texto: Porque «camminare» es un verbo que carece de passato prossimo.
opciones.explicacion: All regular verbs form prossimo passato.

opciones.texto: Because the verb «vedere» can only be used in present time.
opciones.explicacion: «Ho visto» is correctly in prossimo passage.

intro: Learn to accurately alternate the time of the story: imfect for the frame and prossimo passage for the punctual fact.
